notes.title: New Version 102 - New achievement, better hiscores
notes.content:
New version (102) of qrth-phyl should be live now.

- sfx and music volume in options
- quit/back/pause for joystick and keys redefinable
- increase retrieved global scoreboard to 31 entries (scrolly)
- new yumyum achievement
- aspect ratio in game options
- fixed music pause bug
- version number on launcher
​
